items.title: Keep Replies current after reconnecting
items.detail: Tuner catches up pending prompts and changed read positions, plus a small set of recent conversations. On first load, it checks recent conversations and restores pending prompts.

items.title: Compatibility
items.detail: Compatible with: Tightbeam 0.1.16 (build 4283) and Chat v0.1.100. Chat v0.1.101 does not work in Tuner.
